usage: 香茅 is often used to add a lemony flavor to dishes.
It is a popular ingredient in Southeast Asian cooking.
Fresh 香茅 can be identified by its strong citrus smell.
You can find 香茅 in herbal teas and soups.
香茅 stalks are usually bruised or crushed to release their aroma.
